ModMetaData.name: Armor Integrity (Prototype v2.1)
ModMetaData.author: PhillipFrei
ModMetaData.description: Prototype v2.1. One hit wears exactly one outermost armor layer. All core armor checks use Sharp. Apparel wear accumulates precisely even below one hit point, only one Battered bar is shown, and legacy Armored Up BatteredArmor saves are recognized.
